mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mt_promotion_metric_snapshot ( shop_id, biz_date, slot_time, primary_balance, common_balance, promotion_balance, cost_counter_value, metrics_trusted, untrusted_reason, payload_json, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{shopId}, #{bizDate}, #{slotTime}, #{primaryBalance}, #{commonBalance}, #{promotionBalance}, #{costCounterValue}, #{metricsTrusted}, #{untrustedReason}, #{payloadJson}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE primary_balance = VALUES(primary_balance), common_balance = VALUES(common_balance), promotion_balance = VALUES(promotion_balance), cost_counter_value = VALUES(cost_counter_value), metrics_trusted = VALUES(metrics_trusted), untrusted_reason = VALUES(untrusted_reason), payload_json = VALUES(payload_json), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
